name: JoAi: Send Artifact Delivery

description.en: Send a finalized delivery message for one or more artifacts on email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Marks included artifacts as sent. For MCP/agents that already drafted the message — no interactive review step.
description.de: Sendet eine fertige Liefernachricht für ein oder mehrere Artefakte per E-Mail, SMS oder WhatsApp. Markiert enthaltene Artefakte als gesendet. Für MCP/Agents mit fertigem Nachrichtentext — ohne interaktive Freigabe.

bot: Use when the final delivery message is already written (e.g. MCP deliver_artifacts). Pass artifactIds (comma-separated), message, integration (default email), optional subject and contactIds (comma-separated; one id is fine as a single-item list). Does not draft or prompt for edits.

inputs.name: Artifact IDs

description.en: One or more artifact IDs, comma-separated

inputs.bot: Comma-separated hash IDs included in this delivery.

description.en: Email subject when integration is email

inputs.name: Message
inputs.bot: Complete delivery body with every artifact URL and password the client needs.

inputs.name: Contact IDs
inputs.bot: Recipient hash IDs, comma-separated. One recipient = one id. If omitted, unique contacts on the artifacts are used.
